retrievalProfile.description: A dark, celestial composition featuring a central botanical subject framed by a marbled border and high-contrast condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, vertically oriented silver-grey rose bud with a long stem sits against a deep black starfield. A thin, glowing red light trail spirals around the rose. The entire scene is enclosed within a thick, ornate marbled border in blue and gold tones, topped with large, condensed sans-serif display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Central verticality of the rose against the horizontal weight of the top text
High contrast between the black void and the vibrant marbled border
Dynamic movement of the red light trail contrasting the static botanical subject
Juxtaposition of formal sans-serif and elegant cursive script
coreInvariants: Deep black background with sparse star-like points

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A single rose bud on a long stem, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, drops down to the rose, follows the red light trail spiral, and is contained by the outer marbled frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the central rose to create a sense of cosmic isolation.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale cream and orange-red for typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the light trail and blue/gold for the marbled border
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright text/rose and the absolute black background; muted saturation in the rose itself.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-condensed sans-serif and formal copperplate script
letterConstructionRules: Display text: extremely high aspect ratio, uniform stroke width, flat terminals.
Script text: flowing, connected, slanted, fine-line weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Display text features a subtle orange drop shadow to create depth against the black.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, vertical sans-serif and fluid, horizontal script.

avoid: Centering the script too far from the display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold, high-impact sans-serif look.
Provides the elegant, formal cursive contrast needed.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a central oil painting of a silver-grey rose bud on a long stem against a pitch-black background with tiny white stars. Add a thin, glowing red light trail spiraling around the rose. Frame the entire image with a thick, traditional blue and gold marbled paper texture border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, extra-condensed cream-colored sans-serif text at the top center with a thin orange drop shadow. Below it, add a line of elegant white cursive script.

verificationChecks: Is the marbled border present and distinct from the black background?
Is the display text extremely condensed and tall?
Does the red light trail appear to glow?
Is the rose centered and vertically oriented?

adjustableVariables: Color of the glowing light trail

avoid: Clashing font choices like Comic Sans

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the marbled border is perfectly rectangular and frames the scene.
Check that the red trail has a soft glow effect.
Verify the condensed text is legible despite its narrow width.
Confirm the rose has a metallic or silvery sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central botanical subject + cosmic black void + glowing light element + marbled frame + condensed sans-serif/script pairing.
